name: coding-practices
title_zh: 每次提交前自动过一遍的代码守门员
tagline_zh: 写码、改码、测试、审查，全程有它盯着。提交前不点头，你别想宣称完工。适合记性差、总漏检查的开发者。
tagline_en: Write, change, test, review—it watches every step. Won't let you claim done without a final pass. For devs who.
desc_en: Always-on rules for writing, changing, testing, and reviewing code in any language. Use on every coding task and before claiming any work is done.
why_zh: 不是一次性检查，而是常驻规则。它把散落的工程纪律收编成一套流程，逼你在每个环节都过一遍。
why_en: Not a one-off linter but persistent rules. It turns scattered engineering habits into a checklist, forcing review at each stage.
limit_zh: 只约束你主动调用的场景，不自动扫描仓库；需要你按它的规则逐项确认，无法覆盖团队私有规范或特殊框架的隐含约定。
limit_en: Only applies when you invoke it; no auto-scan. Requires manual sign-off per item; won't cover team-specific or framework-hidden conventions.
title_en: Always-on code gatekeeper before you call it done
